name: 30 DAS 持续上限自愈（←Down 无 Up：ARR 0.6s 后强制停 + das stop reason=timeout；根治点按连走）

asserts.source:
local logs = query.logs()
local moves, stopAt, lastMove = 0, 0, 0
for i, l in ipairs(logs) do
  if l:match('^move x=%d+$') then moves = moves + 1; lastMove = i end
  if l:match('^das stop reason=timeout') then stopAt = i end
end
assert(stopAt > 0, 'no timeout log, moves=' .. moves)
assert(lastMove < stopAt, 'move after timeout stop')
return true
